definitions.explanation: Chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart muscle, typically due to narrowed coronary arteries. Often triggered by exertion or stress.

⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{狭心症|きょうしんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Going up stairs brings on an angina attack.

notes:
Compound of {狭|きょう} (narrow) + {心|しん} (heart) + {症|しょう} (illness, condition). Refers to the symptom complex caused by narrowed coronary arteries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧: angina attack
- {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患|わずら}う→患う：27883_wazurau⟧: to suffer from angina
- {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: treatment for angina

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}→心筋梗塞：20487_shinkinkousoku⟧: myocardial infarction; heart attack — when a coronary artery is completely blocked; more severe than {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}
- {心臓発作|しんぞうほっさ}: heart attack (colloquial) — non-medical umbrella term covering both
